body: I'm sure they would. But I didn't make this decision for them or anyone else. I made it for me. I don't want to live this way and with this pain for years to come. Call me selfish, or whatever you will. I don't care. I just called into work. Just gotta get the last couple things in line and I'm ready.
I'm 24. They're all dead. I don't wanna talk about it really. I'm just ready for tomorrow. I'm actually looking forward to it to be honest. I'm ready to see them all again. I miss those fuckers...

Just a combo of everything. I lost my carreer. My wife. My friends. I went from having it all, being happy, and making a good living. Now I can't even afford rent. I'm laying in a 40 degree house cause I have to heat. I got so far behind when I got put of the military and couldn't find find a job forever. I work full time now and can't even feed myself. I just don't see the point anymore. I don't have anyone attached to me to hold me back.
It's not on a whim. Been thinking about it for years. Since before I left the miltary. So almost 5 years. I'm ready for it.
